questions.question_english: 31. What role does SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) play in digital content delivery within an LMS?

Acting as a physical cabling standard for connecting interactive whiteboards to computer displays
Enforcing mandatory monetary billing and subscription fee collection per student login session

questions.explanation_english: The Sharable Content Object Reference Model establishes universal technical standards for structuring, packaging, and delivering digital e-learning content. SCORM compliance ensures that instructional materials, interactive modules, and assessments are fully interoperable, allowing them to run smoothly across diverse learning management platforms without requiring technical modification. This standardization protects institutional investment in course content, simplifies content migration between software ecosystems, and enables accurate tracking of learner completion metrics.

questions.question_english: Which design principle ensures accessibility for visually impaired students accessing digital classroom resources?
options_english: Providing descriptive text alternatives (alt-text) and ensuring screen reader compatibility
Using low-contrast color schemes with minimal text options across all visual interfaces
Encapsulating all written text inside nonscalable visual image files to prevent editing
Disabling audio descriptions and subtitling functionality across embedded instructional videos
questions.explanation_english: The design principle that ensures accessibility for visually impaired students involves providing descriptive text alternatives, commonly known as alt-text, and ensuring compatibility with screen readers. Alt-text serves as an auditory description of visual content, allowing visually impaired learners to understand images and graphics through assistive technologies. By adhering to these accessibility standards, educational institutions can create inclusive digital environments where all students, regardless of their visual abilities, can engage with learning materials effectively.

questions.explanation_english: Discussion moderation tools in an LMS allow educators to oversee and guide asynchronous online forum conversations effectively. Instructors can review, approve, pin key discussion threads, or remove inappropriate posts to maintain constructive academic discourse and safe online spaces. Moderation features help align student discussions with learning objectives, encourage respectful communication, eliminate spam or off-topic content, and highlight exemplary peer responses for collaborative learning.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। LMS में चर्चा moderation उपकरण शिक्षकों को असिंक्रोनस ऑनलाइन फोरम वार्तालापों की प्रभावी निगरानी और मार्गदर्शन करने की अनुमति देते हैं। शिक्षक महत्वपूर्ण चर्चा थ्रेड की समीक्षा, अनुमोदन, पिन कर सकते हैं, या अनुचित पोस्ट को हटाकर उत्पादक शैक्षणिक संवाद और सुरक्षित ऑनलाइन स्थान बनाए रख सकते हैं। मॉडरेशन सुविधाएँ छात्र चर्चाओं को शिक्षण उद्देश्यों के साथ संरेखित करने, सम्मानजनक संचार को प्रोत्साहित करने, स्पैम या ऑफ-टॉपिक सामग्री को समाप्त करने और सहयोगात्मक अध्ययन के लिए उत्कृष्ट सहपाठी प्रतिक्रियाओं को उजागर करने में मदद करती हैं।
